info.title: Sekretär sidecar API
info.summary: Loopback API of the Sekretär Python sidecar 0.1.0. See contracts/api-v1.md.
info.description: Normative contract: contracts/api-v1.md. Every response is an envelope `{requestId, data}` or `{requestId, error:{code,message,details}}`; `X-Request-Id` mirrors requestId. Mutating requests require `Content-Type: application/json`. The event stream is `WS /api/v1/events?cursor=<seq>` with subprotocols `sekretaer.v1, bearer.<token>` (envelope: contracts/events/event-1.0.schema.json).
